limitations: Static source review only; no runtime/browser verification.
The contact sheets were generated from the already-dirty worktree state present when this review began; no claim is made that sprite files changed during this audit.

Alpha integrity was not individually measured; transparency impression is not an alpha-channel audit.
Procedural effect families without resolved body PNG remain unresolved.
NPC Brute dispositions inherit source PNG verdicts for Bruno and do not establish runtime rendering or appropriateness of sharing the pack.
